turns.question: Between 1 and 10 October 2026, how many euros less did a first-time buyer's order come to, on average, than a returning customer's?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: there is no average order value for first-time buyers versus returning customers, and no dimension that splits orders by whether they are a customer's first, so I can't give that difference for 1 to 10 October 2026. The closest metrics are Average order value (EUR) (average_order_value_eur, all non-cancelled orders), Revenue from repeat customers (EUR) (revenue_repeat_customers_eur), Repeat customers (repeat_customers) and Repeat-customer revenue share (repeat_revenue_share), where a repeat customer is one who has placed two or more orders in all.
